items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: And Odell was playing with me -- Odell and Charlie Parker, and several of the boys. All of them was Kansas City boys.

ctx.x: You have no idea who started him?

No. I think he was playing down at the Atlas Club. Down there in Kansas City in them packing houses, the man had a big club down there. It was kind of like a dance hall, a beer tavern, kind of like a (?), but it was a big place. He was a White man. And Odell was playing with me -- Odell and Charlie Parker, and several of the boys. All of them was Kansas City boys. But Neal would come down there and sit in. And I think I saw him one night give Charlie one of them cigarettes.
